notes: hw1 script builds a PDF report from InputDS.Ipums2005Basic (an IPUMS extract the course provided; excluded from the repo by .gitignore as proprietary). script.sas mocks the same 8 columns (ownership, state, metro, city, hh_income, home_value, mortgage_payment, citypop) with 15 inline datalines rows (kept inside script.sas, not autoexec.sas, so the bundle is self-contained and reproducible via a script-only POST to /v1/quick). autoexec.sas is just the standard obs=100 cap. Replaced the original 'x cd ...' OS-shell + libname setup with direct libnames into WORK (mechanical only). One correctness fix applied: the source used the undocumented singular 'option nodate;' -- SAS 9.4 only documents the plural OPTIONS statement (no OPTION alias found in documentation.sas.com), so this was rewritten to 'options nodate;' to preserve the author's intent using valid syntax. All PROC CONTENTS/SORT/FORMAT/PRINT/MEANS/FREQ logic, titles, footnotes, and labels are otherwise unmodified from the source. Bundle still runs and produces the full report end-to-end (status ok, exit 0) and is pinned as-is; a genuine Jenner engine gap was found while reviewing this run's PROC MEANS output (CLASS+FORMAT grouping uses the raw unformatted value instead of the documented formatted-value grouping) and filed as an isolated minimal regression test upstream (internal tracker only, not referenced in the PR).
